candidate.title: MES opening-range breakout parameter grid
candidate.one_line: Test whether MES continues after breaking several predeclared cash-session opening ranges.

hypothesis.behavior: MES may continue in the breakout direction after a completed five-minute close exceeds the completed 09:30 ET opening range.
edge_reasoning: Opening-range breakouts are a common intraday momentum hypothesis, but their value on MES must be tested after realistic costs.
failure_theory: False breakouts may dominate after costs.
Long and short behavior may differ.
The result may be sensitive to the opening-window length or confirmation offset.

setup: Build the MES cash-session opening range from 09:30 ET for the selected predeclared number of minutes.
entry: After the range is complete, require a completed five-minute close beyond the range by the selected tick offset.
Enter in the breakout direction at the next contiguous five-minute bar open.
Take no more than one trade per session for each configuration.
exit: Exit at the final same-session boundary and hold no overnight position.

range_minutes.rationale: Owner-requested bounded comparison of short and conventional opening windows.

breakout_offset_ticks.rationale: Bounded confirmation sensitivity without adaptive expansion.

direction_variant.rationale: Keep directional behavior separate and visible.

special_assumptions.entry_fill: Next five-minute bar open after a completed breakout close.
special_assumptions.costs: One MES contract with stored commission, exchange fees, and one tick of slippage per side.

candidate_specific_checks: Evaluate exactly the 42 predeclared configurations without parameter expansion.
Keep long and short variants separate in ranking and evidence.

implementation_notes.expected_custom_logic: Reuse the registered MES ORB adapter with the immutable 42-configuration StudyPlan.

sources.title: Owner-authorized MES ORB parameter-grid request
sources.creator: Terry
sources.claim: Run MES ORB across 5, 10, 15, 20 and additional bounded opening-window variants so the real workflow is populated.

source_assessment.agreement: This is a falsifiable owner-authorized research hypothesis, not a profitability claim.
unsupported_claims: No claim of profitability or robustness is made before testing.

possible_duplicates: Earlier shallow MES ORB baseline research
claimed_difference: This run uses the current canonical Candidate pipeline and retained per-configuration evidence across the expanded predeclared windows.

qf_interpretation.entry: Next-bar entry after the first completed close beyond the selected opening-range boundary and tick offset.
